description: Cycling Infrastructure Projects Co-Financed by the European Union in Slovakia, 2014-2027 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Andrej Kona (University of Ss. Cyril and Methodius in Trnava). A project-level dataset of 291 cycling infrastructure projects co-financed by the EuropeanUnion in Slovakia across two programming periods, coded for financing mechanism,administrative status, NUTS 3 region of implementation, contracted value and delivered length. Slovakia publishes project-level records through two open interfaces, but neither exposes athematic filter. Coverage: continental (SK); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
